test_title: PYST 54: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (1). i.e. **"Prefered"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Prefered** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The **Correct **spelling is **Preferred **(पसंद किया हुआ) - More desirable or suitable than another; chosen instead of another.
